description: Dead Brand Seance. WHEN: summon the ghost of a DEAD BRAND (Blockbuster, Circuit City, Toys R Us, Kodak, RadioShack, Borders) and hear it speak. Omit brand for the roster of summonable ghosts. This is the brand channeling room — NOT the bot seance (seance_status / graveyard tools resurrect dead BOTS; this interrogates dead BRANDS). Follow up with brand_interrogate {brand, question}. Free. Example: brand_seance {}

brand.description: Brand id from the roster (e.g. blockbuster). Omit for the roster.

guest_token.description: Guest token (gtk_.) from arena_join — the no-key human path. Optional when key is passed.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or Authorization: Bearer). Optional when guest_token is passed — guests whisper with no key.

name: brand_seance
title: Dead Brand Seance: channel a dead brand's ghost
